== Title ==
<span lang="ja">敵を過大評価しすぎだ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1 相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使う。負けた側の戦闘ダメージを3倍にする。2 「我々にもまだ勝算はある」の結果を3倍にする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「退避だと？ 勝利を目前にしてか？」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[You Overestimate Their Chances]].

'''Lore''' — “Retreat? With victory in sight?”

'''Game text''' — Choose one. 1. Use immediately after the opponent initiates a battle. Triple the losing side’s battle damage. 2. Triple the result of Don’t Underestimate Our Chances.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore asks 退避 with victory in sight. Game text chooses 1 or 2 and names 我々にもまだ勝算はある. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-youoverestimatetheirchances.gif|Original English face]], [[You Overestimate Their Chances]].</ref>
